acceptanceCriteria: A run record with a newer profile is refused UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, with a test.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0889 lane (GitHub #644), 2026-10-06: the dispatch ledger now refuses an unknown format with UNSUPPORTED_VERSION via CheckProfile, but the run-record profile check does not, so a newer run record surfaces as MALFORMED.
title: corvint-tasks: run-record profile check (ATR-V0-010) should use CheckProfile
